description: For aos configuration files that use $ref/$env (for plain data use json_ls). Same as json_ls plus: follow: true goes through $ref on the way to the place; resolve: true lists the value with $ref/$env resolved (e.g. the merged tool list of a tools.json). Example: {"path": "tools.json#/tools", "resolve": true}. Details: knowledge_read aos/tools/jsonx_ls.json.

path.description: FILE#/POINTER in one string, e.g. cfg.json#/states/think/next; FILE alone = the whole document; FILE#/ is the key named "" (RFC 6901). Relative files start at your workspace.

follow.description: true = go through $ref on the way to the place

resolve.description: true = look at the value with $ref/$env resolved (default: as written)

long.description: true = also print each child's type and size

offset.description: start at this child (for the next page)

limit.description: at most this many children (default: env AOS_JSON_MAX_ITEMS, else 200)
